messages:
anya: Heads-up — Orchid onboarding next week. We need per-customer flags + a gated rollout for a couple of features (payment-express, advanced-rl, dedicated-logs). Putting initial plan here so we can do async checks.
kevin: Which flags are we planning to turn on first? production immediately or canary?
sophie: my vote is canary for payment-express only initially. Keep advanced-rl off until we validate quality.
anya: Agreed. Proposal: allowlist by tenant_id=9876, start canary at 2% traffic for 2 hours, then 10% for 24h if metrics look good. Contract gating: enforce plan >= enterprise_plus for dedicated-logs.
rahul: FYI the tenant_flags table supports per-tenant keys. Schema is tenant_flags(tenant_id, flag_key, enabled, scope, metadata_json, expires_at). I'll open a migration if we need a new index for fast lookups. Example snippet:
```
UPDATE tenant_flags SET enabled=true, metadata_json = '{"source":"onboard-orchid"}' WHERE tenant_id=9876 AND flag_key='payment-express';
```
kevin: Naming convention? `cust_{tenant_id}_{flag}` or keep key as the feature name and separate tenant column? prefer consistent lookup.
anya: Keep keys as feature names and use tenant_id column. That maps better to existing rollout code. For allowlists maintain `enterprise_allowlist_v2` in config-store and reference in code. TTL for trial entries: 90 days.
sophie: Alerting/guardrails: 95th latency, error rate, and key revenue_events. Specifics: rollback if error_rate > 1% above baseline for 5m OR p95 latency degrades > 200ms vs baseline for 5m.
rahul: I'll add an alert rule in Grafana: `orchid_payment_express_error_rate > 0.01 for 5m` -> pager oncall. Also will add a dashboard row `/dash/flags/orchid`.
deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: routing 2% of Orchid traffic for `payment-express` from 2026-03-17T14:30Z to 2026-03-17T16:30Z. Monitoring hooks: /dash/flags/orchid, /alerts/teams/eng-platform.
kevin: Code review ping: PR #542 has the tenant lookup + feature flag check. Can someone review? cc @sophie @rahul
sophie: Reviewing now, left one comment about a null check. :thumbsup:
rahul: I'll fix the migration and add the index. Also will emit audit log entries on toggle changes: `actor`, `tenant_id`, `flag`, `action`, `reason`.
kevin: Do we need legal sign-off before enabling contract gating? they already signed enterprise_plus in the contract, but want an audit trail.
anya: Contract clause confirmed by @legal earlier today. We'll include audit events and email notification to AMs on first enable.
kevin: One more ops question — cleanup for allowlist: auto-expire after 90 days for trials, manual retention for permanent enterprise entries.
anya: Action items: (1) rahul add migration + index + alerts (2) kevin merge PR #542 after Sophie OKs (3) sophie finish review (4) anya coordinate AM email and confirm legal note. We'll flip the canary tomorrow morning if all green.
sophie: acked, will finish review by EOD.
rahul: acked, will roll out alerts and index before canary.
anya: Thanks team. If anyone sees a spike during canary, tag `@oncall` and I'll trigger the safe rollback."
